scope: Saved paired real-aircraft validation only. No native PSNR/SSIM or native ground-truth inference.

design.original: 6000 updates; L1+.05 edge through4000, plus .03 ROI LPIPS on updates4001..6000
design.reconstruction: 6000 updates; L1+.05 edge throughout; same LR schedule
design.experimental_units: 61 validation objects in4 held-out locations, each clean/sensor;122 cases are not122 independent objects
design.weighting: Within-location case mean, then equal-location mean; regime summaries use the same4-location macro weighting
design.native_display: 20px input ->80px learned output;400px interpolation display only

protocol_all_differences.original: Match aircraft footprint, use native unupsampled HR truth and genuine pretrained x4 reconstruction to avoid unsupported20x texture synthesis. Compare two pretrained degradation priors at identical data/optimization budget.
protocol_all_differences.reconstruction: Remove the LPIPS training term while retaining identical official classical initialization, real training data, augmentation, seed, optimizer and6000updates. Inspect whether native diagonal textures are absent and reconstruction gains retained.
Prospective reconstruction-only control after native-panel artifact rejection; no paired test opened
New fine diagonal stripes in native24018 and24259; preserve original6000perceptual result as rejected evidence

protocol_all_differences.original: Separate highest ROI-PSNR and lowest guard-eligible LPIPS checkpoints on grouped validation. Final candidate needs actual whole-plane visual review and comparison against bicubic, old C20 and B20 on identical grids. Do not report native PSNR without HR. Final test only after candidate identity freeze.
protocol_all_differences.reconstruction: Highest grouped validation ROI PSNR, tie earliest, plus original structural guard and actual native29+val8 visual veto. No automatic fallback. Test only after new freeze.
Only permits equal reconstruction/total budget and additionally hashes its own filename; all optimizer/data/loss implementation identical.

inputs.note: Manifest metadata includes all split names; no test image payload opened.

configuration_check.batch_identity_limitation: Same seed, serial-indexed sampler and augmentation code imply identical sampling; no per-update input-tensor hashes were logged.

pre_loss_change_parity.interpretation: Compares saved validation metrics, not image tensors or parameter equality. Deviations are reported, not suppressed or automatically rejected; hardware/software numerics may differ, but this file does not attribute causality without environment evidence.

clean_lr_definition: same_operator_lr_mae downsamples prediction with matching PIL bicubic and compares with clean LR, including sensor-input cases; it is not native truth.

native_artifact_evidence.path: D:\超分实验\飞机超分突破诊断_20261005\final_preview\independent_visual_review.json
native_artifact_evidence.finding: 24018 的机体和右侧背景出现初始化没有的明显细密重复斜纹；24900、24938、26236、28200、30600 等也可见同类方向性细纹。即便验证主体清晰，仍应否决此 checkpoint 的该视觉门槛。
native_artifact_evidence.review: Labeled nonblind model visual review; separate from paired validation metrics

limitations: A single seed and four validation locations do not establish population-wide generalization or causal certainty.
Only the training loss schedule is intended to differ; final candidate selection policy also differs and is disclosed in protocol differences.
Equal-step 6000 comparisons are the loss ablation; best-checkpoint selection is not used to substitute unequal steps here.
Total training loss values are not directly comparable after4000 because one arm includes an LPIPS term.
No new-arm native artifact disappearance can be claimed from numeric metrics; requires separate actual image review.
Any parity failure must be reported and investigated rather than assuming identical trajectories.
